hero.heading: Garden Family Villa
hero.tagline: Space, stone, and a kitchen that feels like home

overview.body1: The Garden Family Villa is a spacious 2-bedroom retreat set within a lush tropical garden — open-plan living, a fully equipped kitchen, and stone walls that keep the space cool and characterful. Designed for families who want space without sacrificing style.
overview.body2: With two bedrooms, generous living areas, and a private garden setting, this villa offers the freedom of a home away from home in one of the Caribbean's most beautiful destinations.
